description: Join a dedicated team at a skilled nursing facility in Oakland, MD, as an SDC/Infection Control Nurse. This vital role combines staff development and infection prevention to ensure the highest standards of care and employee competency within the facility.As an SDC/Infection Control Nurse, you will be instrumental in coordinating staff education programs, implementing robust infection control protocols, and ensuring compliance with all relevant health regulations. Your expertise will contribute directly to patient safety and the professional growth of our nursing team.This position offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42. We are seeking a committed professional to make an immediate impact. Apply today to learn more about this exciting opportunity.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, preferably in a long-term care or skilled nursing setting
Experience or strong interest in staff development and education
Knowledge of infection prevention and control principles and practices
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: This position offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42.

description: Join a premier skilled nursing facility in Sarasota County, FL, as an Experienced Marketing Director. This is a unique opportunity to lead marketing initiatives for a recently acquired center, playing a pivotal role in its growth and success. We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven professional to enhance our community presence and drive admissions.In this key leadership position, you will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies, building strong relationships with referral sources, and ensuring a consistent census. The ideal candidate will possess a proactive approach, strong business acumen, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, including working occasional weekends to meet organizational goals.This role offers a highly competitive compensation package for the right individual, reflecting the importance of this position to our facility's future. If you are a strategic marketer with a passion for healthcare and a proven ability to achieve targets, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably within a skilled nursing or healthcare setting.
Demonstrated ability to drive census growth and build strong community relationships.
Professional demeanor and excellent presentation skills.
Flexibility to work occasional weekends as needed.
Strong initiative and a results-oriented mindset.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Highly competitive compensation for the right candidate.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and skilled PRN Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This critical role offers a competitive hourly rate and the flexibility of PRN scheduling, allowing you to make a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being.

As an SLP, you will provide essential speech, language, and swallowing therapy services to patients, helping them regain vital communication and cognitive functions. This is an urgent need, and we are looking for a compassionate professional ready to contribute to a supportive team environment.

Take advantage of a generous $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus, reflecting our commitment to attracting top talent. Join a facility that values your expertise and provides an opportunity to truly make a difference in the lives of others.
requirements: Current and valid state licensure as a Speech-Language Pathologist in Florida
Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC) from ASHA
Experience in a rehabilitation or skilled nursing facility setting
salaryOrBonusInfo: $38.00 - $49.00 per hour, plus a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus.

description:
Join a dedicated team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL, as a Per Diem Physical Therapist. This is an excellent opportunity for a skilled PT seeking flexible PRN shifts to provide high-quality therapy services to patients, helping them regain independence and improve their quality of life. You'll work in a supportive environment focused on patient-centered care and professional growth.

We are looking for a compassionate and experienced Physical Therapist to contribute to our rehabilitation programs. This role offers competitive hourly compensation, allowing you to balance your professional commitments with personal life while making a significant impact on patient recovery. If you are passionate about rehabilitation and thrive in a dynamic setting, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current and valid Physical Therapist (PT) license in Florida
Minimum of one year of experience as a Physical Therapist, preferably in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
Ability to commit to PRN (as needed) shifts
Strong clinical assessment and treatment planning skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $39.00 - $40.00/hr based on experience.
